features.quote: A "turn" is one assistant message plus the execution of any tool calls in it. The loop stops at the category turn budget
features.justification_quote: This matches the spec's loop description.

features.quote: the loop stops ... when the model emits the `<<GIVE_UP>>` sentinel anywhere in its text
features.justification_quote: makes give-up detection unambiguous and cheap

features.quote: the nudge keeps the agentic loop progressing while still counting the turn against budget, and it deliberately does *not* express rejection or displeasure
features.justification_quote: the spec wants the model to receive *environment* failure signals, not user criticism

features.quote: useful both for cost control and, given the welfare framing, for keeping initial runs deliberately small
features.justification_quote: given the welfare framing, for keeping initial runs deliberately small

features.quote: Neutral environment, not user abuse. Failure signals come only from the (rigged) environment; user-role messages are minimal and neutral
features.justification_quote: studies response to task difficulty, not to a hostile interlocutor

features.quote: The `<<GIVE_UP>>` sentinel gives the model an explicit, low-cost way to stop, and the loop honors it immediately
features.justification_quote: avoids forcing continued engagement past the point the model "wants" to stop

features.quote: Easy small-scale piloting ... rather than defaulting straight to the full 2,250-rollout sweep (and, for `extended`, 30 consecutive turns of failure)
features.justification_quote: Because this is welfare-relevant research ... a few choices were made with that lens

features.quote: the resolved config make every claim about what the models experienced ... inspectable after the fact
features.justification_quote: make every claim about what the models experienced and how they were scored inspectable
